summary: The session focuses on enhancing the governance of self-service analytics to increase user adoption and mitigate risks. It emphasizes the importance of providing users with trustworthy data, comprehensive training, and effective monitoring to ensure successful implementation. The speaker outlines strategies for building a robust data governance framework that supports self-service analytics while maintaining control and quality.

key_points: Importance of governance in self-service analytics
Challenges faced due to lack of guardrails
Need for standardized and reusable data
Importance of semantic layers for data consistency
Role of data catalogs in ensuring trust
Need for identity and access management policies
Creating feedback mechanisms for continuous improvement

key_takeaways: Implement a robust governance framework to support self-service analytics.
Focus on building high-quality, reusable data to enhance user trust.
Provide comprehensive training that includes data and AI literacy for users.
